title: Crossover Dribble in the Chair
description: Players practise a low crossover dribble from one side of the chair to the other, the seated equivalent of changing direction with the ball to beat a defender.

content.objective: Move the ball low and quickly from one side of the chair to the other without raising it.
content.setup: Players sit with a ball, enough space to dribble on both sides of the chair.
instructions: Dribble low on the right side of the chair for five touches.
Cross the ball low in front of the chair to the left side.
Dribble low on the left for five touches, then cross back.
Repeat continuously for 30 seconds, keeping the ball below chair-seat height throughout.
coachingPoints: Keep the crossover low — a high crossover is easy to poke away.
Use the fingertips to push the ball across quickly.
Keep the eyes up once the pattern is comfortable.
commonMistakes: Letting the ball rise above seat height during the cross.
Watching the ball instead of an imaginary defender.
Watching the ball instead of keeping the head up.
content.safety: Leave enough space between players for the ball to cross safely.
